homePage.seoTitle: Mysterria - 詭秘之主 Minecraft 伺服器
homePage.heroTagline: 服下魔藥，扮演角色，從序列9一路攀向神位--在灰霧將你吞沒之前。
homePage.circleTitle: 原著中的每一種力量，都可實際遊玩。
homePage.circleLede: 我們自研的外掛完整實現了非凡者力量體系--22 條途徑、魔藥、儀式、扮演與失控。無需任何模組即可遊玩；客戶端伴隨模組則會補上視覺效果。
homePage.circleStepOneBody: 搜刮會自動補充的箱子、與其他玩家交易，或獵殺神秘生物，以獲取 22 條途徑中任意一條的序列9魔藥配方。
homePage.circleStepTwoBody: 收集主材料，操作鍊金鍋，然後嚥下自己的命運。能力是真實的，靈性消耗也是真實的--若你貪快，失控同樣真實。
homePage.circleStepThreeTitle: 扮演你的角色，然後晉升。
homePage.closingLede: 免費加入。Java 26.1.2 以上版本，接受資源包，你的第一個序列大約只需一個晚上。

terms.title: 魔法體系委託
terms.whatIsIt: 一項客製化開發服務，讓魔法使用者可以針對現有法術、機制或能力，申請聚焦且符合設定的調整--先由我們的測試員與開發者審核，再由工程團隊直接實現。
requestOptions: 每份申請共享 6 點預算--一項重大改動消耗 3 點，一項細微改動消耗 1 點。
最多 2 項重大改動--一次完整的設定校正重寫、一項能力的平衡重製，或一個新法術／新成長曲線的加入。
最多 6 項細微改動--小幅數值調整（冷卻、傷害、法力消耗、成長係數）或小幅設定風味修改，可跨一個或多個法術／能力。
在預算內自由搭配--例如 1 項重大 + 3 項細微正好用滿 6 點，與單獨 2 項重大或 6 項細微相同。
requirements: 有正當理由--說明其背後的玩法或設定考量。
符合設定--立足於既有的世界觀／原作素材，而非憑空創造。
非根本性--不涉及核心系統重製或架構變更。
顧及近期工作--不要僅因為想換個思路，就申請重做一個近期已被重製、目前狀態良好且平衡的法術／能力。若它確實自那以後變得失衡、過時或損壞--無論上一次是誰改動的--都可以正當申請。
howItWorksSteps: 測試員與開發者審核其可行性與設定準確性（管理團隊核驗）。
通過的申請會被排期並實現。
terms.note: 超出上述範圍的申請會被拆分為多份委託--在進一步收費之前，我們會明確告知你需要幾份。

hero.lede: Pick one of the 22 Pathways and drink your way up its potions, from a Sequence 9 Beyonder to a god's throne at Sequence 0. Free to play, no mods needed.

deck.boonNote: Boons are raised beside your Pathway by sacrifice at an altar, never ahead of it.
deck.ladderLabel: The {name} Pathway, from Sequence 9 to the top

rung.title: Sequence {n}: {name}
rung.start: Where every Beyonder begins. The first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.
rung.digest: You reach it by acting out your current role until its potion is digested, then brewing the next one. Rituals matter more with every step.
rung.demigod: The last Sequence open to everyone. Every seat above it is limited.
rung.seats: Only {count} Beyonders of this Pathway can hold it at once. When it’s full, a seat war decides who does.
rung.throne: The Pathway’s god: one throne, held by one player until they stop playing or the season ends.
rung.full: Every ability of this Sequence, in full

progression.title: From potion to power

discover.title: Find the formula
discover.copy: Every Pathway starts from a written formula, and its ingredients are scattered across the world.

brew.title: Brew the potion
brew.copy: Build a Magic Cauldron and add the ingredients in the formula's order. Get the order wrong and the brew fails.

drink.title: Drink the potion
drink.copy: One swallow and you're a Beyonder of the {pathway} Pathway. The first potion asks for no ritual and costs no Madness.

formula.label: Sequence 9 formula: {sequence}
formula.detail: {pathway} formula: main ingredients left, supplementary right.

cauldron.label: Magic Cauldron
cauldron.detail: Follow the formula’s ingredient order. Failed brews keep your ingredients.

sequencePotion.label: {sequence} potion
sequencePotion.detail: Sequence 9 potion. Expires after two real-time days.

drinkPotion.label: First potion
drinkPotion.detail: Your first potion needs no ritual and costs no Madness.

book.sealLabel: {pathway} Sequence 9 formula. Requires a Magic Cauldron.

drink.about: Every Pathway climbs ten Sequences, from 9 up to its god at 0. Each potion you digest takes you a step higher, and the higher ones also demand rituals.

progression.boonNote: A Boon rides beside a Pathway and never ahead of it, so every Boon-bearer starts here, with a potion of their own. The Fool shows how.

pantheon.title: Become a god
pantheon.body: Each of the 22 Pathways has one throne at Sequence 0. Reach it and you become that Pathway's god, with a title above your head and a spell no other player has.
pantheon.rule: No one can take a throne by force. It only passes on when its god stops playing, and every throne opens again when the season ends.

climb.title: Climb to Sequence 1
climb.body: Seats above Sequence 4 are limited. When a rung is full, you win your seat in a seat war.

prove.title: Prove yourself
prove.body: Hold your Pathway's Uniqueness, lead a congregation and earn legendary deeds. One of them is a public event that plays out your Pathway's role from the novel.

brew.title: Brew the last potion
brew.body: Three Sequence 1 Characteristics of your Pathway, and nothing else. It can't be drunk: only the rite consumes it.

vigil.title: Declare and keep the vigil
vigil.body: The whole server is told. For 72 hours, any rival at Sequence 1 may contest your claim.

rite.title: The rite
rite.body: Everyone gets ten minutes' warning and the coordinates. Witnesses earn acting, and the site stays marked on the map for good.

incursions.title: PvP with real stakes
incursions.body: The open world is safe. When 50 or more players are online, Cosmos Incursions open PvP zones at random spots on the live map, and a zone's colour tells you what you risk by dying there.
incursions.tiersLabel: Zone colours and what dying costs

green.name: Green
green.stake: Drop an item or two. Damage is evened out, so a new Beyonder can still win.

yellow.name: Yellow
yellow.stake: Drop more items. Damage is only partly evened out.

red.name: Red
red.stake: Drop everything you carry. Raw power decides.

black.name: Black
black.stake: Lose to a player and you can lose a Sequence or half your acting.

incursions.permanent: Some zones never close. Loot their points of interest, then hold an extraction point long enough to escape with it.
incursions.logout: Logging out won't save you. Your body stays behind, defenceless.

arena.title: Mythic Bedwars, Duels and FFA
arena.body: Matches are announced in chat: click to join and keep playing until you're pulled in. Everyone starts as a random Pathway at Sequence 9 and climbs by buying Arcane Elixirs mid-match.
arena.safe: Your real character is never at risk, and what you win carries over to it: acting progress, shorter cooldowns, bottles and tokens.

rifts.title: Rifts and dungeons
rifts.body: Rifts stand in the open world as pillars of shifting light. The whole server pours Energy Fragments into one until it gives way to a dungeon, and inside you get one life.

tank.name: Tank
tank.body: Takes the hits and draws aggro. Can't cast.

archer.name: Archer
archer.body: Far stronger arrows, weaker up close.

rifts.guardians: Guardians roam the open world and enrage below 30% health. Bring magic for the end, because below 20% nothing else hurts them. Each kill drops a token you spin for rare loot, Characteristics included.
rifts.alt: A swirling Rift between floating runestones in a ruined tower

churches.title: Churches
churches.body: At Sequence 4 you can found a church by placing its core in the world. Branches carry it across the map and its members' prayer strengthens its perks. Rival churches go to war over each other's cores and vaults.
churches.honorific: Write your Honorific Name, a five-line invocation of who you are, and other players can chant it to reach you through a ritual.
churches.alt: A black and crimson cathedral under the stars

anchors.title: Outer Gods Anchors
anchors.body: An Outer God's seed takes root somewhere in the world, dropping only hints in chat for a day. Then it blooms into alien terrain guarded by its defenders. Wear it down together, then break its heart.
anchors.boons: Your contribution buys rewards, including shards of rare Boons: a second Sequence borrowed from an Outer God and raised by sacrifice.

join.copiedHelp: Copied. Paste into Multiplayer → Add Server.
join.copyHint: Multiplayer → Add Server. No mods needed.

java.name: Java Edition
java.body: Version 26.1.2 or newer. Accept the resource pack when you join.

bedrock.name: Bedrock Edition
bedrock.body: Same address, port 19132, on phone or PC. A few custom menus look simpler.

join.verify: In the lobby, pick Mysteries and link your account with the code on your website profile.

companion.title: COI Client
companion.lede: Our own optional mod gives Minecraft a full Beyonder interface. Every mechanic still works without it.

hotkeys.title: Cast at speed:
hotkeys.body: Bind abilities to hotkeys or a 16-slot wheel.

visuals.title: See the magic:
visuals.body: Ritual circles and casting effects, drawn in full.

madness.title: Feel the madness:
madness.body: Whispers and hallucinations creep in as your sanity slips.

perks.title: Act faster:
perks.body: 2% more acting from every source and 5% shorter acting cooldowns.

ordeals.title: Losing control isn’t the end
ordeals.body: From Sequence 6 up, a Beyonder who loses control is no longer deleted. You’re thrown into an Ordeal instead, and how you play it decides how much of your progress you keep.
ordeals.limit: Lose control a third time within 14 days and the character is gone for good. Below Sequence 6 it still is.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.body: Ninety seconds as a mutated Warden. A higher kill score means a smaller fall.

hollowing.name: Hollowing
hollowing.body: Hours as a wandering spirit, looking for a Wild Beyonder body to take.

sealing.name: Sealing
sealing.body: Locked away for days. Hunting monsters under a rising moon shortens the sentence.

pact.title: A Sequence on loan
pact.body: A Boon is a Sequence an Outer God lends you. It sits beside your own Pathway with its own spells and its own acting, and it raises your Spirituality. The wiki won't even name who grants it.
pact.rule: You can hold one Boon at a time, and it climbs only as far as your own Pathway has.
pact.alt: An Outer God's red eye torn open in the sky, a beam of light falling from it onto a tower by the sea

earned.title: Be of use to it
earned.body: Your first Boon is a reward: for events, the Battle Pass, testing or spreading the word. Aeon, Sublunary and Edict come only as shards from the Outer Gods Anchors.

altar.title: Raise an altar
altar.body: Build a Sacrificial Altar. Any tier works, and a higher one gives better results.

offering.title: Make your offering
offering.body: Sacrifice Beyonder ingredients from the Sequence you're reaching for, or lower. Weak offerings won't buy a strong rung.

refused.title: Never outgrow your Pathway
refused.body: If an offering would lift your Boon above your own Sequence, it's refused, and everything you've offered toward it is lost.

ascensionPage.boonsNote: 恩賜途徑止於序列5，沒有席位。各途徑的非凡者人數：
ascensionPage.error: 無法載入席位資料，請稍後再試。
ascensionPage.empty: 本紀元尚無人登上高序列席位，所有席位都空缺。
ascensionPage.recordsNote: 人數與名稱來自伺服器的玩家紀錄，可能包含不活躍帳號和工作人員帳號，因此可能與遊戲內的席位統計不一致。

helpPage.title: 幫助
helpPage.lede: 玩家在 Discord 上最常問的問題，答案都在這裡。
helpPage.seoDescription: 在 Mysterria 如何綁定 Minecraft 帳號、充值、投票、參加活動、提交工單以及申訴封禁。

linking.title: 綁定你的 Minecraft 帳號
linking.intro: 綁定會把你的網站帳號和遊戲裡的角色連在一起。在商店購物和領取每日獎勵都需要綁定，綁定後你也會在 Discord 上獲得 Verified 身分組。
steps: 用 Discord 登入本網站，然後打開你的個人檔案。
點擊「生成驗證碼」。驗證碼有 8 個字元，10 分鐘內有效。重新生成會取代舊的驗證碼。
進入伺服器，輸入 `/verify <驗證碼>`。只輸入 `/verify` 會開啟一個視窗，可以把驗證碼貼進去。
綁定成功後，Discord 會傳一則訊息給你，個人檔案也不再顯示驗證碼。
linking.offline: 離線帳號在綁定之前無法遊玩。先用 `/register <密碼> <密碼>` 註冊一次，之後每次進服用 `/login <密碼>` 登入。正版帳號不需要這一步。

trouble.detail: 你的帳號已經綁定了。這個按鈕只會在綁定之前顯示。
它已過期，或被較新的驗證碼取代。重新生成一個，並在 10 分鐘內使用。
遊戲進度不會受影響，但網站保存的是你綁定時的名稱，而且無法修改。請在 Account 類別下提交工單，管理團隊會幫你解除綁定，之後你再重新綁定。在那之前，商店發貨和充值都會使用你的舊名稱。

trouble.term: 綁錯帳號或帳號已被占用
trouble.detail: 一個 Minecraft 帳號只能綁定一個網站帳號。如果綁錯了，或你的帳號已被占用，請在 Account 類別下提交工單。
想在兩個版本上使用同一個角色，請先透過 GeyserMC 連結 Java 版和基岩版帳號，再到這裡綁定。沒有連結的獨立帳號會被視為分身帳號。

linking.geyserLink: 在 GeyserMC 連結 Java 版和基岩版

topUps.title: 充值餘額
topUps.intro: 商店以馬克計價，馬克透過 Buy Me a Coffee 購買。1 美元可得 40 馬克，1 歐元可得 44 馬克。
steps: 先登入並綁定你的 Minecraft 帳號。付款會依照你綁定的名稱比對。
點擊網站頂端的餘額，再點擊「充值餘額」。
在 Buy Me a Coffee 的名稱欄位填寫你的遊戲暱稱，必須和遊戲裡完全一致。留言不會用來找到你。
支付你想在餘額裡看到的金額。付款完成後，馬克會自動入帳。
topUps.miss: 名稱比對不到任何帳號時不會入帳，管理團隊會收到通知。請在 Payment / Donation Issue 類別下提交工單，寫明付款時使用的名稱、金額、幣別和時間。服主核實後會手動幫你補上馬克。
topUps.renamed: 改了 Minecraft 名稱？在管理團隊幫你重新綁定之前，請用綁定時的名稱付款。
topUps.donatello: 在網站的烏克蘭語版本中，這個按鈕會開啟 Donatello，並自動填好你的暱稱。

vote.title: 為伺服器投票
vote.intro: 投票可以獲得璀璨商行點數，在 `/emporium` 中使用。每個網站每 24 小時接受你一次投票。
steps: 在遊戲裡輸入 `/vote`，或打開下方的網站。
準確輸入你的遊戲名稱。基岩版的名稱以一個點開頭。
vote.notCount: 名稱必須屬於已經進過伺服器的玩家，而且和遊戲裡的寫法完全一致。24 小時內在同一個網站再次投票也不會計入。
vote.more: 商行點數也可以透過每日連續登入和錯誤回報獲得。

events.title: 活動與時間
events.intro: 大多數活動會在線上人數足夠時自動開始，所以沒有固定的時間表。開始前伺服器會在聊天中公告。

rows.detail: 每 5 小時一次，前提是至少有 40 名玩家在線。開始前 60、30 和 10 分鐘會有提醒。輸入 `/bedwars` 查看下一場的時間。獎勵每天最多 8 份。
線上玩家達到 50 人或以上時開始，最多每 5 小時一次。倒數 3 分鐘後開始，持續 30 分鐘。如果你在區域內下線，會有一個 Hollow 在原地留 5 分鐘。結果會發布在 Discord 的 #events 頻道。
伺服器大約每 3 天嘗試放置一個，前後浮動 12 小時，前提是至少有 5 名玩家在線。伺服器時間 02:00 到 08:00 之間不會開始。錨點孕育約一天，期間每 30 分鐘在聊天中給出提示。
每天一個修正效果，以七天為一週輪替。`/coi tide calendar` 可以查看接下來 14 天。
建築比賽、錦標賽、知識問答和尋寶活動會在 Discord 的 #announcements 頻道公布，各有各的規則。活動商店會在公告寫明的日期關閉。

epochs.title: 紀元
epochs.intro: 一個紀元就是世界的一輪。紀元結束時伺服器會清檔：地圖和所有玩家進度從頭開始，網站上的綁定也會被清除，所以每個人都要重新綁定。
epochs.now: 第一紀元於 {end} 結束。目前的第二紀元於 {start} 開啟。
epochs.next: 第二紀元的結束日期尚未公布。清檔沒有固定週期，請留意 Discord 的 #announcements 頻道。
epochs.carry: 能保留下來的東西很少。會保留的獎品在發放時都會說明。上一次，Server Slam 獎勵和給獨特性持有者的獎勵被帶進了第二紀元。

support.title: 支援、檢舉與申訴
support.intro: 支援透過我們 Discord 伺服器上的工單進行。關於遊戲機制的問題，在指南或維基裡往往能更快找到答案。
steps: 打開 #create-ticket 頻道，需要烏克蘭語協助則打開 #створити-заявку。
選擇合適的類別並描述發生了什麼事。寫上相關名稱和時間，有截圖的話一併附上。

categories.detail: 遊戲內的問題需要協助。
遊戲或網站上有東西壞了。
改了 Minecraft 名稱、綁錯帳號或其他帳號問題。
馬克沒有入帳，或其他付款問題。
你認為某次封禁應該解除或縮短。
投訴某位管理團隊成員。會直接交給服主。

support.appealIntro: 處罰以警告計算，每條警告在發出 6 個月後失效。累積 8 條有效警告會被永久封禁伺服器和 Discord，警告失效也不會撤銷封禁。
appealSteps: 提交工單。封禁申訴請選擇 Ban appeal。
說明你因為什麼、在什麼時候受到處罰，以及為什麼應該更改。
一位未參與此事的管理員會審核申訴，可以減少或撤銷你的警告。減免和解封會公開發布，決定為最終結果。
support.lost: 只有在確認是伺服器故障時才會補發物品，例如當機或虛空漏洞。請提交工單，寫明時間和遺失的物品。

rows.detail: 端口 25565。伺服器執行 26.2，26.1.2 仍然可以加入。

joining.launcher: 請使用官方啟動器或 SKLauncher。不要使用 TLauncher：管理團隊認定它是惡意軟體。

client.title: COI Client
client.body: 為 Mysterria 打造的選用 Fabric 模組。它提供非凡者介面，帶有能力快捷鍵和儀式視覺效果，不裝它遊戲的所有內容也都能正常運作。目前有適用於 26.1.2 和 26.2 的版本。
